description: This file contains a PHP test class 'LeaveEntitlementDaoGetLeaveBalanceTest' which tests the 'getLeaveBalance' method of the 'LeaveEntitlementDao' class within the context of leave balance calculations for employees. It sets up various scenarios with mock services and asserts expected leave balances under different date conditions and configurations.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDaoGetLeaveBalanceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the 'getLeaveBalance' method in LeaveEntitlementDao with various scenarios, including date boundaries, multiple entitlements, unlinked leave, and no entitlements.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of LeaveEntitlementDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalance
methods.description: Performs extensive assertions on 'getLeaveBalance' for various date scenarios and employee/leave type combinations, checking expected LeaveBalance objects.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithUnlinkedLeave
methods.description: Tests leave balance calculation when unlinked leave periods are involved, with mock strategies returning specific date limits.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedLeaveWhenAfterPeriod
methods.description: Tests exclusion of unlinked leave when the specified period ends before the unlinked leave period.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedBeforePeriod
methods.description: Tests exclusion of unlinked leave when the period starts after the unlinked leave period.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedLeave
methods.description: Tests case where no unlinked leave limits are returned, expecting default leave balances.
